# Vendored preview libraries

These browser assets are pinned and served locally so private vault content is never sent to a CDN.

- highlight.js 11.11.1 — BSD-3-Clause — https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
- Marked 18.0.6 — MIT — https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify 3.4.11 — MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify

Update the versioned files and this manifest together after reviewing upstream release and security notes.
